column1: # What the worker script starts and stops on request (P/02.4 N1.5 rules 2–4; ADR-0084 addendum (1) R1, R4, addendum (4) R26).
# Form: the adjacent README. Stage A (A6).

column4: note
want 3: two ordered workers beside the base worker
Start the smallest missing free number
Number 2 is free: start it first
Fill gaps using the smallest numbers
The target is reached: no action
Excess workers have the largest numbers
Interpret numbers as integers: 9 and 10 exceed want, so stop both; start missing 2 (ADR-0084 addendum (4) R26)
want 1: only the base worker remains
10 follows 9
No row: neither start nor stop (R1)
A value outside 1..99 makes the row unreadable: no action
Outside 1..99: no action
A leading zero violates the M10/9 metric form: no row, no action
A fraction violates the M10/9 metric form: no row, no action
A silent console is no reason to act (rules 2, R1)
Do not stop workers during silence either
Reconciliation is older than 60 s (rules 2)
-1 means no reconciliation yet (rules 2)
60 is not older yet (rules 2)
60.5 is fractional per the row value form and older than 60 (rules 2; C02-RECONCILE-AGE-FORM-01)
0.5 is fractional per the row value form and not older (rules 2; C02-RECONCILE-AGE-FORM-01)
1e1 is not the canonical row value spelling (P/06.5 N3: 10), hence out of form (rules 2; C02-RECONCILE-AGE-FORM-01)
Missing roles/<role>.env: skip the role (rules 4)
A zero divisor: skip (rules 4)
A non-positive budget: skip
A non-integer budget: skip
CAPACITY is not > 0: skip
Ceiling 8 exceeds the target: start normally
Ceiling 4 includes the base worker: add three, not four (rules 4)
Ceiling 1 permits only the base worker: no starts
Absent CAPACITY is not an integer > 0: skip (rules 4; M10/3–5 reconciliation, V2)
Use numbers, not a count: 5 exceeds want, so stop it; 3 is missing, so start it despite two running workers (ADR-0084 addendum (4) R26)
